claims.text: Mistral released Vibe 2.0 on January 27 as a terminal-native coding agent powered by the Devstral 2 model family.
The release added custom subagents, multi-choice clarifications, slash-command skills, unified agent modes, and automatic updates, with availability on Le Chat Pro/Team plus PAYG or BYOK paths.

limitations.text: The announcement is vendor-authored; claims about productivity or model quality are not independently reproduced.
Devstral 2 itself predates January, so the month-level event is the Vibe 2.0 agent/harness update rather than a new underlying model family.
